scripts.db:setup: wrangler d1 execute DB --remote --file=schema.sql && wrangler d1 execute DB --remote --file=seed.sql
scripts.db:setup:local: wrangler d1 execute DB --local --file=schema.sql && wrangler d1 execute DB --local --file=seed.sql
scripts.db:patch-blogs: wrangler d1 execute DB --remote --command="ALTER TABLE blogs ADD COLUMN created_at DATETIME; ALTER TABLE blogs ADD COLUMN updated_at DATETIME; ALTER TABLE blogs ADD COLUMN published_at DATETIME; ALTER TABLE blogs ADD COLUMN video_url TEXT; ALTER TABLE blogs ADD COLUMN version INTEGER DEFAULT 1; ALTER TABLE blogs ADD COLUMN is_deleted INTEGER DEFAULT 0; ALTER TABLE blogs ADD COLUMN images TEXT DEFAULT '[]';"
